title: 2026 Municipal Elections Candidate Filing is Now Open!
description:
2026 Municipal Elections Candidate Filing is Now Open!

If you’re considering running for office, 
Declaration of Intention week 
starts today and it ends Saturday February 7.
For complete filing requirements, deadlines, and official guidance, 
visit our website, Clerk.LACity.gov/Elections
or call our office at 213.978.0444
